# Aurora Project Plan

Aurora is a fictional internal reporting project.

## Phase 1: Discovery

### Objectives

- Identify primary users.
- Document reporting decisions.
- Review source systems.
  - Finance system
  - Support system
  - Product analytics system

### Deliverables

1. Interview summary
2. Source inventory
3. Initial risk register

## Phase 2: Delivery

### Workstreams

1. Data ingestion
   1. Define schemas.
   2. Implement validation.
   3. Backfill historical records.
2. Reporting
   1. Build overview metrics.
   2. Add drill-down views.
   3. Verify export behavior.
3. Adoption
   - Prepare training material.
   - Run pilot sessions.
   - Collect feedback.

### Milestones

| Milestone | Owner role | Exit condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Design approved | Product lead | Stakeholders approve definitions |
| Pilot ready | Engineering lead | Critical tests pass |
| General release | Program lead | Pilot issues are resolved |

## Phase 3: Review

The review compares observed outcomes with the original objectives. Findings from this section must not be merged into the delivery workstream merely because both sections contain milestone language.
